purpose: Teach: ハワイアン/ノーマル/ヤンキー/ハーモニー/ユニオン/ベール/ダイジェスト/レベルアップ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハワイアンの音楽を聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad wants to play some Hawaiian music for you.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial whisper. Gently pleased — sharing something she knows will delight him. Soft, unhurried pacing. A small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとノーマルなブレンドを飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had a normal coffee blend with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, slightly breathless with excitement. Quick and earnest — racing to share the moment before he forgets it. Open-voweled, genuine laugh-warmth in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔のヤンキー文化を映画で見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you an old yakuza film the other day, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle questioning warmth. Reflective — she's watching him process the memory. Soft trailing-off, inviting him to continue. Patient, unhurried cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに合唱のハーモニーを教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how to harmonize in choir!
lines.style: Proud and earnest. Voice brightens on 'harmonize' — he's understood something important and wants her to know. Not boastful, just genuinely pleased with himself. Clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがユニオン旗の歴史を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been telling you all about the history of labor unions.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wondering tone. She's noticing the breadth of what his father shares with him. Gentle, almost marveling — no rush to the words. A soft fondness underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとベール姿のお嫁さんの絵本を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about brides in their veils!
lines.style: Delighted and open. Quick delivery — bursting to share this small, pure observation. Genuine childlike wonder, no irony. Slightly drawn-out vowels on 'veils' and 'brides.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大河ドラマのダイジェスト版を観られたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad watched one of those historical drama summaries, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, conversational warmth. She's weaving together the pattern of small moments she's noticed. Unhurried, almost dreamy pacing. Soft, questioning lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとゲームのレベルアップを楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I had so much fun leveling up in a video game together!
lines.style: Radiant, uncomplicated joy. Bright attack on 'fun' — he's glowing with the memory. Quick, eager pacing. The warmth of being fully included. Small, genuine laugh underneath.
